moments.text: Infrared view down onto a dark mottled surface: horizon bar with a circle, crosshair and brackets inside an irregular black redaction mask.
A small dark spot appears just under the right arm of the horizon bar and drifts toward the centre circle.
A small tracking box replaces the crosshair and grows into a large frame, then a tall rectangle; the spot slides left past the bar's end.
Vertical stripe noise covers the picture, with banded bright-and-dark flashes at 10.9 s and 12.8 s; the surface looks more rippled in between.
Clear again: the dark spot sits right of the horizon bar, dips below its end, then hangs just above the right arm near the circle.
As a new tracking box appears, the spot streaks down-left across the horizon bar as a dark dash and leaves the left edge.
Crosshair back. The dark spot slips in and out along the left side near the angle readout, sliding down then up; gone by 23 s.

notes: Clip is 23.6 s, summary says 28 s. Square picture inside black bars plus white pillarbox bars at far left/right; crop None, not cropped.
